items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: always had a lot of fun with Carney back in those times

ctx.x: Oh, Lawrence and I used to get together, and Cootie, Cootie was younger then. He liked to play a lot, you know, and he'd play a lot. And, of course, Johnny didn't,

he didn't do too much jamming around. And Johnny was always kind of quiet back there in those times to me. But Duke had a trumpet player -- Whetsel, Arthur Whetsel. Chief we called him. He used to love to play. He played soft, mute and pretty things, you know. Harry Carney -- always had a lot of fun with Carney back in those times.
